# WO-09 F-CONTENT — the small valid 2D authored project

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `scenes/Main.cscene` | The F-CONTENT scene the serializer itself wrote (one of every 2D content type — sprite + animation, tilemap, light, environment, canvas + button + text, a NativeScript with pending fields, an opaque unknown block, a hierarchy). Loaded by the C05 headless case; re-generated by `ContentScene()` in `tests/test_wo09_c05_json.cpp`. |
| `prefabs/Imported.cprefab` | A hand-authored prefab with a 2D sprite, a **3D** `MeshRenderer` block, an unknown `FutureThing` block and a child carrying a `Light2D` + a 3D `DirectionalLight`. The C05 editor host "imports" it into a real project (InstantiatePrefab + RecordSpawn, the K13 viewport-drop path) and the out-of-process oracle checks the 3D/unknown blocks survive the editor's save. |

The corrupt/malformed variants live in `../corrupt/`.
